name: Damaged
summary: This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged. While damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

summary: This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged. While damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Damaged
summary: This ability takes the form Damaged X. While a model's remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged. While damaged, that model's attacks have -1 to Hit rolls.

name: Aerial Manoover
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

name: Ammo Runts (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Arrogant Invulnerability
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 AP.

name: Beast Snagga Following
summary: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly Beast Snagga unit, excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units, this unit has Lone Operative.

name: Blitz Dem Gitz!
summary: In your Shooting phase, if this unit's Blitzkannon weapon targets a unit that is not a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that weapon has +6 Attacks.

name: Bomb Squig (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Bomb Squigs (Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit)
summary: Usable once per turn and twice per battle by this unit. In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

name: Boss’ Ammo Runt (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, this model's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Boss of da Hunt
summary: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly Beast Snagga unit (excluding MONSTER CHARACTER units), this unit has Lone Operative.

name: Brutal Impact
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's attacks have +1 D.

name: Bust ’Em
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is busted until the end of the turn. While a unit is busted, friendly Speed Freeks units' attacks that target it have [Lethal Hits].

name: Catch Dat Red Bit (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. When this model uses its Crude Surgery ability, you can add D3 to the number of wounds healed. Place a token next to the unit, removing it when this ability is used.

name: Clever Know-wotz
summary: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Orks Vehicle model (excluding AIRCRAFT/TITANIC models) within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model heals D3 wounds, and that VEHICLE model's attacks have +1 to hit rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Crude Surgery
summary: In your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

name: Da Grand Warlord's Ladz
summary: While this unit is within 3" of another friendly Orks Infantry unit, this unit has Lone Operative.

name: Deff from the Shadows (First battle round onwards)
summary: At the end of your opponent's Movement phase, if this unit is in strategic reserves, this unit can make an ingress move.

name: Dodge Dis!
summary: This unit's attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Downtrodden
summary: When determining transport capacity, every 2 Gretchin models (rounding up) count as 1 model.

name: Dread ’Ard
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 Damage.

name: Drive-by Skorchin’
summary: In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units. Until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot be targeted with the Fire Overwatch stratagem.

name: Even More Dakka
summary: While this unit is riled up, its ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Finderz Keeperz
summary: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 AP if either of the following applies: this unit is within range of an objective; or the target of that attack is within range of an objective.

name: Fix Dat Armour Up (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, in your Command phase, this unit heals 3 wounds.

name: Found ’Em!
summary: In your Movement phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That unit has +3" detection range until the end of the turn.

name: Fully Loaded Butchery
summary: This unit's Butcha Boyz weapon gains +2 A for each model embarked within this unit, to a maximum of +22 A.

name: Get Back in da Race! (Once per battle round, per army)
summary: Usable once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Speed Freeks unit within 6" of this unit. That unit, and any units embarked within it, is no longer battle-shocked and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

name: Get Out da Way!
summary: While making a charge move, this unit can move through models, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE models.

name: Go fer da Weak Spot
summary: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks that target a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit have +1 to wound rolls.

name: Gut Hatch
summary: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, units embarked within this unit can make an assault disembark move.

name: Hardy Bioniks
summary: Attacks that target this unit with a Strength greater than this unit's Toughness have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Hero of the Imperium (Aura)
summary: While a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit is within 6" of this model, that unit can re-roll battle-shock rolls.

name: High-speed Carnage
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have +1 Strength and +1 Damage.

name: Idol of Belligerence
summary: In your Movement phase, when a unit embarked within this unit is selected to make a disembark move, that unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

name: Intimidating Motivation (Once per battle round, per army)
summary: Once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, select one friendly ORKS unit within 6" of this unit. That unit is no longer battle-shocked, and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

name: Keep Huntin’! (Once per battle round, per army)
summary: Usable once per battle round, per army. In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Beast Snagga unit within 6" of this unit. That unit is no longer battle-shocked, and is riled up until the start of your next turn.

name: Krushin’ Impetus
summary: When this unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in this unit engaged with that enemy unit. For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

name: Kustom Dakka
summary: This unit's ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

name: Madcap Artillery
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if all ranged weapons equipped by each Mek Gunz model in this unit are the same, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that unit has the ability matching that weapon's name: Bubblechukka — wobbled: while a wobbled unit is attacking, its targets have the benefit of cover against those attacks. Kustom Mega-kannon — zapped: that unit has -1 Ld. Smasha Gun — smashed: that unit has -2" M. Traktor Kannon — grounded: it cannot take to the skies.

name: Makari, Hoist Dat Banner! (Once per battle, per army)
summary: Once per battle, per army. In your Movement phase, select a number of friendly ORKS units equal to or less than the current battle round number. Those units are riled up until the start of your next turn.

name: Mobbed
summary: When this unit ends a charge move, each enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with this unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that roll, or with -2 to that roll instead if this unit has 13+ models.

name: Mobile Arsenal
summary: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Mobile Fortress
summary: Ranged attacks that target this unit have -1 D.

name: Nazdreg’s Know-wotz
summary: This unit has Deep Strike. This unit's ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

name: Never Too Busy to Fight
summary: Being engaged does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

name: Paired Krumpas
summary: Attacks made with this model's Kustom Krumpa weapon can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls.

name: Pilin’ Out
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this model, units embarked within this model can make a disembark move using the rapid disembark mode.

name: Prophet of da Great Waaagh! (Aura)
summary: Aura. While a friendly ORKS unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls and +1 to wound rolls.

name: Psychic Blank
summary: This model has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Push Dat Bit Back In (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Command phase, select one friendly Beast Snagga unit within 6" of this unit. That unit heals 3 wounds.

name: Raucous Occupants
summary: While this model is within range of your home objective, add the OC of models embarked within this model to this model's OC.

name: Rokkit Barrage
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

name: Rokkit Charge
summary: When this unit is selected to fight, if it made a charge move this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1 A and +1 S, and have [Hazardous].

name: Runnin’ wiv da Herd
summary: While this model is attached to a Mounted unit, it loses the INFANTRY keyword, gains the MOBILE and MOUNTED keywords, and adds +4" to its Move characteristic.

name: Speednob Support
summary: While each model in this unit is within 3" of a friendly Speed Freeks unit, this unit has Lone Operative. WARTRAKK units do not count for this check.

name: Spiteful Power Trip
summary: While this unit makes attacks against a target unit that contains no models with a Toughness characteristic of 7 or more, add 1 to those attacks' Hit rolls.

name: Squig Barrage
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by this unit's Squig Launchas weapons, excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units. That enemy unit is covered in Squigs until the start of your next turn. While a unit is covered in Squigs, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Sumfin’ to Prove
summary: Melee attacks made by this unit have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Support Shokka
summary: While this model is within 3" of a friendly Orks Infantry unit, excluding Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun units, this model has Lone Operative.

name: Supreme Kunnin’ (Once per phase, per army)
summary: Once per phase, per army. In the opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D6"; or, if this unit is riled up, make a normal move of up to 5".

name: Taktikal Know-wotz
summary: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each with a starting strength of 5. If you do, select which one of those units has the Bomb Squig ability and which one has the Found 'Em! ability.

name: That’ll Learn Ya (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Usable once per battle round, per unit. When this unit becomes battle-shocked, if this unit contains 4+ Gretchin models, you can roll one D3. That number of Gretchin models in this unit are destroyed, and this unit is no longer battle-shocked.

name: Thundering Stampede (Aura)
summary: Friendly Beast Snagga units within 6" of this unit have +1 to charge rolls.

name: Tide of Muscle
summary: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

name: Tramplasquig Charge
summary: When this unit is targeted with the Crushing Impact stratagem, that use of the stratagem costs 1 fewer CP.

name: Trapped by Excuses
summary: In the Deploy Armies step, you must set this unit up on the battlefield or embarked within a TRANSPORT unit that is set up on the battlefield. Abilities that allow you to redeploy a unit or place a unit in strategic reserves cannot affect this unit or a TRANSPORT unit this unit is embarked within.

name: Unparalleled Luck (Once per battle, per army)
summary: Usable once per battle, per army. At the start of a phase, the controlling player may use this ability; if they do, this model has 2+ InSv.

name: Waaagh! Effigy
summary: This unit is riled up.

name: Waaagh! Energy (psyker level 1)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section (see above).

name: Wurrboy (psyker level 1)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section (see above).

name: Da Boss
summary: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

name: Unstable Energies
summary: ORKS PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name. In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.
